display_title: Ladies at Her Service: The Demon Princess's First Love
description:
As a child, Lulu the demon princess yearns for the love described in novels from the human world, but is scorned by the heartless demons around her. So she searches for love in the human world and meets Ha-Yeon, a cheerful girl who offers to draw her. Lulu instantly falls for Ha-Yeon’s supportive nature and artistic passion, which prompts her to seek her out again as an adult ten years later. Although Ha-Yeon is now a disillusioned ex-artist who barely remembers Lulu, the demon princess is determined to make her first love come true, no matter what!

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.*
